Why Use Screen Time Swap?

Screen Time Balance

Help kids swap passive screen time for active, creative, or social experiences.

New Activity Discovery

Introduce kids to hobbies and activities they might not try on their own.

Parenting Made Easier

When kids are bickering over "what to do," let the wheel pick and remove the negotiation.

Tips for Screen Time Swaps

  • ✨Let kids pick from the wheel themselves — ownership increases cooperation
  • ✨Make the swap feel like an exciting trade, not a punishment
  • ✨Join in! Parents who participate create stronger family bonds
  • ✨Build up to longer activities gradually — start with 15 minutes

The goal isn't to take away fun — it's to add more fun! Screen time and real-world activities can both be part of a healthy day.
